description: This line plot illustrates the relative change in performance metrics across different layers of a model’s architecture under varying token and precision configurations for KV cache compression. The x-axis represents five distinct layer ranges: “Layer1-4”, “Layer5-12”, “Layer13-20”, “Layer21-28”, and “Layer29-32”, plotted on a linear scale without numerical tick marks. The y-axis represents “Relative Change” in percentage, ranging from -25% to 5%, with tick marks at regular intervals of 5%. Four distinct lines are plotted: a yellow line with circle markers representing “LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit”, a red line with square markers for “LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit”, a cyan line with circle markers for “RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit”, and a dark blue line with square markers for “RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit”. The yellow line remains nearly flat near 0%, starting at approximately 0.2% and ending at 0.4%. The red line starts near 0%, dips to approximately -5.5% at Layer13-20, and recovers to about -0.5%. The cyan line begins near 0%, dips to approximately -16.5% at Layer13-20, and rises to about -1.5%. The dark blue line starts near -4.5%, dips to approximately -24.5% at Layer13-20, and rises to about -4.5%.
